item.title: Which of Your Azure Resources Are Zone Resilient
item.description: Are you wondering which of your Azure resources are zone resilient and which are not? The Resources view in Azure Infrastructure Resiliency Manager answers that for everything in your scope.

item.title: Getting Started with Azure Infrastructure Resiliency
item.description: Are you trying to figure out how resilient your Azure infrastructure really is? I went looking at the new Resiliency section in the Azure portal and found quite a bit of information on how resilient my infrastructure really is!
